title: Present Simple
summary: Use Present Simple to talk about routines, habits and facts.

explanation.en: We use Present Simple for routines, repeated actions, permanent situations and facts.
explanation.ru: Present Simple используется для регулярных действий, привычек, постоянных ситуаций и фактов.

examples.en: She goes to school every day.
examples.ru: Она ходит в школу каждый день.

forms.label: Questions
forms.pattern: Do + subject + verb? · Does + subject + verb?

examples.en: Does she have breakfast at home?
He watches TV and studies English.
examples.ru: Он смотрит телевизор и учит английский.

commonMistakes.note: With he, she and it, add -s/-es.
After does, use the base form.
